Add a question and choose Rating for a row of stars.

![The a star rating question selected in the editor, its settings outlined.](../../../docs/question-types/star-rating-editor.png){width=100%}

## What the respondent sees

![The question as the respondent sees it.](../../../docs/question-types/star-rating-preview.png){width=90%}

## Settings

- **Number of stars.** The top of the scale. The answer is the number of stars given.

## Best practices for research

Use stars for an overall judgement. For a scale of several items, use Likert questions that share an answer set.

Reference: Dillman, D. A., Smyth, J. D., & Christian, L. M. (2014). *Internet, phone, mail, and mixed-mode surveys: The tailored design method* (4th ed.). Wiley.
